lateral_flank_blob_constellation.centroid_triangulation: A series of high-luminance circular clusters are arranged in approximately five visible vertical columns posterior to the gill slits, displaying a semi-regular spatial distribution along the mid-lateral axis.
lateral_flank_blob_constellation.stripe_intersections: Vertical bands of elevated pixel intensity intersect with the horizontal rows of high-luminance blobs, creating a discernible grid-like pattern of anchor nodes across the visible mid-section.

carinae_gradient_vectors.ridge_trajectory: A prominent longitudinal feature is visible in the upper third of the flank, exhibiting a sharp vertical luminance gradient with high-intensity highlights on the superior edge and deep shadowing on the inferior edge.

acquired_anomalies_or_scars: A distinct V-shaped notch or indentation is visible on the posterior trailing edge of the left pectoral fin, indicating physical tissue loss.
other_distinctive_markers: The pectoral fin displays a high density of small-diameter, high-luminance speckles that are significantly more concentrated and less organized than the primary lateral flank blobs.
